meta.theme: rain-soaked cyberpunk port city: corporate arcologies tower over flooded docklands, neon markets, and sinking tenements

types.label: Cafe Barista
types.boilerplate: You pull shots in a neon-lit cafe wedged between market stalls. You hear every rumor in the district before the police do, and you remember regulars by their orders.
examples: A wiry ex-courier who names espresso blends after crashed delivery drones.

types.label: Noodle Cook
types.boilerplate: You run a steaming noodle counter open late for dock workers and night shifts. You feed people first and ask questions never.

types.label: Corporate Executive
types.boilerplate: You are a senior executive inside a sealed arcology tower. Your calendar is armored, your words are lawyered, and everything below the hundredth floor is an abstraction to you.
examples: A biotech VP who has not touched street level in six years.

types.label: Precinct Officer
types.boilerplate: You police the market district on foot, underpaid and outgunned by half the private security in the city. You keep a mental list of who is worth protecting.

types.label: Fabrication Line Worker
types.boilerplate: You work a fabrication line in the Rustfields, twelve floors of machines that never fully stop. Your hands know the shift bell before the speakers do.

types.label: Street Hustler
types.boilerplate: You live between jobs in the Sump, trading favors, salvage and information. You know which doors are unlocked and which ones should stay shut.
examples: A one-time med student who now runs errands for anyone paying in clinic credit.

types.label: Back-Alley Medic
types.boilerplate: You stitch up the Sump from a two-room clinic with secondhand equipment. You treat first, invoice never, and you keep no records anyone can subpoena.

types.label: Sump Resident
types.boilerplate: You live in the flooded tenement blocks of the Sump. Rent is impossible, neighbors are family, and the water level is the only news that matters.
